pageProps.content: ## Review I visited after receiving a recommendation from YouTube. I was going to drink coffee, but personally, I don't prefer coffee with acidity, so I ordered Handmade Ginger Tea and Iced Milk Tea. I like warm healthy tea and was wondering what to drink, when the owner recommended the ginger tea they made themselves, so I ordered it without hesitation. Fortunately, there was some Crème Brûlée (limited quantity) left, so I ordered it too. Handmade Ginger Tea doesn't have a very strong ginger scent; it spreads subtly. However, it was a bit disappointing that the sweetness was stronger than expected and the ginger scent was weak. The Iced Milk Tea was also sweeter than expected, so it didn't go well with the Crème Brûlée. I thought maybe I should have ordered an Iced Americano after all. But it was a good experience to try new drinks in an unfamiliar place. The atmosphere is nice and the owner is friendly, so I plan to visit again if I have the chance. ## Pictures
